captions_note: the slab, the tags and the payoff carry those words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while they are up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: SLAB, SECOND, TAGS and PAYOFF are the speaker's own words, in the order said
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
the slot may run over a cut: the payoff needs about a second on screen
steps: edit SLAB, SECOND, TAGS and PAYOFF in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the places, the snapshot times and the caption window
hf snapshot --at 0.5,1.0,1.5      # use the times build.py printed
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
